summary.name: Paper Cutout Illustration. Category: Printmaking and Craft Materials. Provenance: explicit.
summary.visualIdentity: Objects are built from clearly cut paper shapes with thin visible edges and soft contact shadows, using limited paper colors and material types. Pieces move on believable joints by sliding, rotating, or folding, without intersections or conflicting shadow directions.
summary.suitableUses: Inferred suitability: stories where separable jointed paper pieces can explain the subject. Explicit guidance says to use this style alone when jointed pieces and contact shadows carry the story. Target audiences, durations, and topics are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Explicit constraints: keep paper colors and material types limited, and avoid piece intersections and conflicting shadow directions. Paper.js provides no physical paper texture or 3D curl. Procedural curl is artistic, not a physical solver. Add depth or 3D only when required.
summary.palette: Suggested, not supplied: background #F2EAD8, foreground #304849, accent_1 #C17F63, accent_2 #829776. Task-provided or approved colors override these and must be preserved. Foreground on background reaches 8.161:1. Accents fail the 4.5:1 text target, so they are decorative only. Gradients are disabled, and assets must not be recolored.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit primary motion is deliberate pose changes through pivots and parent-child joints, with optional procedural paper curl. Video state must derive from seekable composition time, not live input. Optional reference motions (gaze tracking, miniature parallax, chaptered transitions, scroll storytelling) apply only when scene assets support them. Avoid automatic springs or extra easing.
summary.audio: Unspecified for this style. Suggested audio should derive from the topic, audience, storyboard, and motion, and honor any user requirements. Options include music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence. No fixed genre, tempo, or mandatory layer is assigned. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, and absence of clipping.
summary.assetRequirements: Prepare paper contours, contact shadows, pivots, and a parent-child joint hierarchy. Layered PNGs need alpha transparency, consistent dimensions, clear naming, and a layer manifest or numbered frames. Vector morphs need compatible segment structures. Fonts and assets must be preloaded. No source artwork or audio is supplied.
summary.combinations: Paper Cutout works alone or with style-101 for whole-plane parallax under one fixed light direction. It can also pair with style-097 for cut-paper charts limited to three categories, with no curl on data marks. Hybrids are advised only for formal depth or precisely quantified information. Avoid deep perspective, blurred depth, and reversed parallax speeds.
summary.productionApproach: Visual construction belongs to SVG, layered PNG assets, or optional PixiJS and Paper.js renderers. GSAP owns motion, with one owner per animated property. HyperFrames is the primary pipeline for composition, validation, and export, and Remotion is only a documented fallback. Verify decoded frames, direct seeks, and audio sync. Distinguish simulated appearance from photographed production.
